A '''script''' served as the written form of the [[Givin (language)|Givin language]] spoken by the [[Givin/Legends|species of the same name]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]]. In keeping with Givin society's obsession with mathematics, the script included hundreds of mathematical symbols.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Givin script was mentioned in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
